aforecapital-gamma-app:ashbyhq:623482be-.company: Pre-Seed Series a Series b Series c Series D Series E IPO Gamma AI Build beautiful presentations with generative AI. Bay Area
aforecapital-gamma-app:ashbyhq:623482be-.description: ABOUT THE ROLE This is a career-making opportunity to own Gamma's B2B product roadmap end to end. You'll define and ship features that drive enterprise adoption and expansion, from workplace integrations to admin controls and brand governance. You'll balance the needs of enterprise and SMB customers while maintaining the consumer-grade experience Gamma is known for. You'll serve as the standard-bearer for customer interactions, trusted by leadership to stand at the front of any room or sit at the head of any table. You'll own the relationship across Sales, CS, GTM, legal, and compliance, and you'll be raring to spend time with our biggest customers, both selling the vision and resolving challenges. The raw material at Gamma is unmatched: a beloved product, a strong consumer brand, a clear enterprise use case, a peerless AI offering, and GTM counterparts personally recruited by our founders on the basis of their excitement to operate within a product-led culture. Plus, it's a lot of fun. How many B2B roles are anchored in channeling wild creativity into undeniable results? Our team has a strong in-office culture and works in person 4–5 days per week in San Francisco. We love working together to stay creative and connected, with flexibility to work from home when focus matters most. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Own the B2B product roadmap end to end, defining and shipping features that drive enterprise adoption and expansion - Be the voice of enterprise discovery: in rooms with enterprise buyers, understanding their workflows, surfacing unstated requirements, and bringing that signal back to shape the roadmap - Serve as the standard-bearer for high-quality customer interactions, trusted by founders and leadership to represent Gamma in any setting - Build cross-functional credibility with Sales, CS, and GTM, acting as the connective tissue between product and the teams in front of customers - Balance the needs of enterprise and SMB customers, and partner with compliance, enterprise IT, legal, and security, while maintaining Gamma's consumer-grade product experience - Work hands-on with engineers to ship complex, scalable systems that meet enterprise requirements around security, permissions, and compliance - Define success metrics and drive toward ambitious goals for revenue, adoption, and customer satisfaction WHAT YOU'LL BRING - 6+ years of product management experience with at least 3+ years focused on enterprise B2B product-led growth SaaS or AI go-to-market motions - A genuine preference for the early-stage startup environment: you're energized by ambiguity rather than looking for a settled playbook - The ability to inspire a team and bring fresh thinking to enterprise problems, rather than running the same playbook again - Technical fluency to discuss complex tradeoffs with senior backend engineers, particularly around security, scalability, and integrations - Strong quantitative analysis skills and self-starter approach to analysis - Experience working with top-tier designers to ship complex, polished user experiences that work for both end users and admins - Track record of translating enterprise requirements into product strategy and shipping features that drive measurable business outcomes - Customer-facing experience and comfort leading demos, discovery sessions, and strategic conversations with decision-makers COMPENSATION RANGE: The base salary for this full-time position, which spans multiple internal levels depending on qualifications, ranges between $225K - $290K plus benefits & equity. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including but not limited to experience and expertise in the requirements listed above. If you're interested in this role but you don't meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway! We're always excited about meeting great people.

Our guiding principles and ability to generate value for clients sets us apart. Our clients include leading infrastructure funds, pension funds, contractors, and governments. The Opportunity As Director, you will play a pivotal leadership role in leading our North American financial advisory practice. Your Skills and Experience - Minimum eight years of relevant experience in infrastructure finance as a sponsor or as a financial advisor; - Strong deal management and technical delivery capabilities; - Demonstrated ability to structure and execute infrastructure mandates; - Successfully closed challenging infrastructure transactions; - Strong business development and client relationship skills; - Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills; - Ability to work with geographically dispersed teams; - Ability to work under pressure and consistently deliver high-quality work with strict deadlines to meet team and client objectives; and - Willingness and ability to travel. cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:ee.title: Warehouse Associate
cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:ee.description: About the Role The Warehouse Clerk is responsible for the day-to-day management of the warehouse, yard, equipment, tools, materials, and vehicle fleet. This role serves as the primary point of accountability for all inventory and company assets, ensuring everything that enters, leaves, or moves within company locations is accurately tracked and documented. The Warehouse Clerk maintains organized inventory systems that support field operations and ensure crews have the materials and equipment they need to complete projects efficiently. Key Responsibilities Manage all warehouse and yard operations, ensuring materials, tools, equipment, and vehicles are properly logged, tracked, and accounted for. Pick, stage, and prepare materials, tools, and supplies for field crews before scheduled work assignments. Maintain inventory using established minimum/maximum stock levels and proactively replenish inventory to prevent shortages and project delays. Receive incoming materials, equipment, and supplies, ensuring all receiving and inventory transactions are accurately recorded in the company's accounting or inventory management system. Coordinate preventive maintenance and repair schedules for company vehicles, trailers, tools, and equipment, including inspections, registrations, and routine service. Maintain a clean, organized, and secure warehouse and yard environment. Track equipment and vehicle assignments to projects and crews, ensuring all assets are returned, inspected, and documented after use. Maintain accurate records of inventory counts, equipment condition, maintenance history, and asset locations. Identify low inventory levels, aging equipment, damaged tools, or maintenance needs before they impact project schedules. Enforce company procedures for inventory control and asset accountability by ensuring all employees follow established check-in/check-out processes. Assist with periodic physical inventory counts and inventory reconciliations.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:07828579-a5a2-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Business Operations Manager based in Netherlands. As Business Operations Manager, you’ll play a central role in ensuring commercial operations run smoothly across the EMEA region. You’ll act as the operational bridge between Commercial, Customer Success, Finance, Legal, HQ Operations, and external partners. Your scope will span the full commercial lifecycle, from quotations and orders through provisioning, invoicing, renewals, and partner operations. This is an independent, hands-on role where you’ll own issues, coordinate stakeholders, and drive solutions rather than simply provide administrative support. You’ll help identify operational bottlenecks and turn recurring challenges into scalable, standardized processes. Working in a fast-growing healthcare technology environment, you’ll have meaningful exposure to international markets and cross-functional initiatives. The role offers an opportunity to make a tangible impact on operational efficiency while helping support continued expansion across EMEA. Manage quotations and orders by preparing quotes and order forms, reviewing purchase orders, coordinating approvals, and ensuring accurate handovers between Commercial and operational teams. Coordinate order processing and license provisioning, ensuring customer and partner information is complete and resolving operational blockers efficiently. Support invoicing and accounts receivable activities by ensuring invoice readiness, coordinating with Finance, monitoring invoice status and overdue receivables, and resolving billing or documentation issues. Manage renewal operations by maintaining visibility of upcoming renewals, coordinating preparation across relevant teams and partners, and proactively tracking risks and outstanding actions. Support distributor and commercial partner operations, including onboarding, documentation, system access, internal setup, and alignment with operational processes. Coordinate operational requirements for new EMEA markets, working across Commercial, Legal, Finance, Regulatory, Customer Success, and HQ teams. Take ownership of day-to-day commercial operational issues by establishing clear owners and deadlines, coordinating stakeholders, removing bottlenecks, and driving matters through to resolution. Identify recurring operational challenges and develop scalable processes that improve turnaround times, reduce rework, and minimize unnecessary escalations to senior management. Monitor operational performance through metrics such as order-processing times, provisioning lead times, renewal readiness, partner onboarding, AR follow-up, and completion of agreed actions. Requirements: Approximately 4–7 years of experience in Business Operations, Commercial Operations, Order Management, or a related operational role. Experience supporting B2B commercial operations, preferably across multiple countries or international markets. Strong understanding of quotations, purchase orders, invoicing, renewals, and order-to-cash processes. Proven ability to coordinate effectively across Commercial, Finance, Legal, Customer Success, Operations, and external stakeholders. Highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive, with a strong sense of ownership and reliable follow-through. Comfortable working independently and taking initiative in a fast-growing, evolving environment where processes may still be developing. Experience using CRM platforms and other business systems to manage operational workflows and information. Strong written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate clearly with stakeholders across different functions and geographies. Experience in SaaS, healthcare, medical devices, healthcare IT, or another technology-driven environment is a plus. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to turn operational issues into practical, repeatable solutions. Benefits: Full

jobgether-jobgether:lever:803e52d6-10e5-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Engenheiro(a) de Inteligência Artificial (Agentes Conversacionais e A2A) based in Brazil. This role offers the opportunity to engineer advanced AI agents capable of handling complex interactions and solving problems autonomously. You will design conversational assistants, copilots, and multi-agent architectures that collaborate to achieve defined outcomes. The position combines Python engineering with LLM orchestration, RAG, prompt engineering, and agentic AI. You will work with modern technologies across the Google AI ecosystem, including Gemini and Vertex AI. The role also involves connecting agents to APIs, databases, and external tools while ensuring reliable production performance. You will establish quality metrics, improve model behavior, and build robust observability for AI applications at scale. It is an environment suited to a technically strong professional who enjoys innovation, experimentation, and solving complex AI challenges. Design, develop, and continuously improve contextual, responsive, and human-centered conversational agents, including chatbots, copilots, and virtual assistants. Architect multi-agent and Agent-to-Agent (A2A) solutions in which autonomous agents communicate, delegate tasks, and collaborate toward shared objectives. Develop advanced prompt-engineering workflows and RAG pipelines to enable accurate use of proprietary knowledge bases while minimizing hallucinations. Integrate Google AI technologies and foundation models, particularly Gemini and Vertex AI, into production-ready applications. Implement tool-calling capabilities that allow agents to consume APIs, query databases, and execute actions across external and internal systems. Establish and monitor quality metrics covering conversational clarity, context retention, accuracy, and overall agent performance. Monitor inference health, application performance, scalability, and availability in production environments. Build and maintain robust APIs and backend services supporting AI applications and agent architectures. Implement observability, logging, and metrics solutions to identify issues and continuously improve reliability. Contribute to the evolution of AI engineering practices, architectures, and development standards. Requirements: Completed higher education, preferably with a specialization in technology, artificial intelligence, software engineering, or a related field. Exceptional proficiency in Python , including object-oriented and asynchronous development. Extensive experience building and maintaining robust APIs using FastAPI, Flask, or Django . Advanced practical experience with LLM orchestration frameworks, particularly LangChain, LangGraph, and Langflow . Experience working with the Google AI ecosystem, especially Gemini and Vertex AI APIs and services. Strong understanding of agentic AI concepts, including autonomous reasoning patterns such as ReAct , Plan-and-Solve, and A2A workflows. Experience implementing and optimizing vector databases such as Qdrant, Pinecone, Milvus, Weaviate, or pgvector . Practical experience with production observability, logs, and metrics using tools such as Grafana . Experience with containerized environments and orchestration platforms such as Rancher . Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a focus on building reliable, scalable AI solutions. Ability to work with autonomy, continuously learn emerging AI technologies, and translate experimentation into production-ready solutions. zealnetwork-zeal-network:ashbyhq:400b504.title: (Senior) Quality Assurance Engineer (f/m/d)
zealnetwork-zeal-network:ashbyhq:400b504.description: ZEAL Network SE is an international group shaping the future of digital lotteries and dream-driven experiences. As Germany’s leading online lottery provider through LOTTO24 and Tipp24, and a partner of Spain’s ONCE, ZEAL combines innovation, technology, and entertainment to inspire millions of customers. With ventures such as Freiheit+, Traumhausverlosung, Traumautoverlosung and ZEAL Ventures, the company also invests in new business models and emerging e-commerce brands. Driven by a diverse team of 350+ professionals, ZEAL fosters a collaborative, ambitious culture focused on turning dreams into reality. As a (Senior) Quality Assurance Engineer (f/m/d) in our Games Production Team, you will ensure the quality, functionality, and security of our growing portfolio of slot games, instant-win games, and scratchcards. Your work plays a critical role in delivering a reliable and enjoyable experience for players, while also upholding regulatory compliance and safeguarding the integrity of our gaming platform. You’ll help establish and continuously improve QA practices that make our games robust, testable, and ready for release in regulated markets. YOUR TASKS: - Design, build, and maintain automated test suites tailored for slots, instant-win games, and scratchcards, while performing manual testing during development and release phases. - Define and evolve test strategies that address the unique challenges of game testing — including animations, UI responsiveness, game state complexity, and random outcomes. - Collaborate with Game Developers, Game Designers, and Artists in a creative and agile environment. - Maintain structured test documentation, including test plans, bug reports, and regression checklists. - Execute cross-device and cross-browser testing to validate performance, consistency, and responsiveness across platforms. - Ensure compliance with regulatory standards, and support certification-related QA tasks such as preparing test evidence or assisting with audits for relevant jurisdictions (especially Germany). Prior knowledge is a plus, but can also be acquired on the job. - Advocate for a player-first quality mindset, helping the team prevent critical issues that could impact the game experience or platform reputation. WHAT YOU OFFER US: - Practical experience in testing online games, ideally including slot games, scratchcards, or instant-win mechanics. iGaming industry experience is highly desirable. - A solid understanding of game testing challenges, including randomness, animations, math models, and edge-case scenarios. - Familiarity with basic probability and mathematics used in slot game design (e.g., RTP, volatility, win frequency) is a strong plus. - Proficiency with Playwright and TypeScript or similar frameworks for frontend automation. - Experience in manual exploratory testing—you know how to think like a player and uncover hidden issues. - Understanding of QA standards and compliance requirements for regulated markets (e.g., Germany, UK, MGA). - Strong collaboration skills and a proactive mindset—you’re ready to take ownership of quality in a fast-moving team. - Strong English skills are required for collaboration within the team. - Fluency in German is a nice-to-have. WHAT WE OFFER: - State-of-the-art technologies and an agile environment (Check our Tech Radar: https://lotto24.github.io/tech-radar/) - A modern, dynamic culture grounded in the success of a leading-edge e-commerce company. - A talented team of ambitious, like-minded colleagues where your knowledge and ideas truly make an impact. - Ongoing personal growth, supported by an annual development budget of €1,500 to invest in your professional development. - Trust and autonomy, no micromanagement, just confidence in your ability to deliver and excel. - Flexible work options with a hybrid setup focused on results. - Unlimited vacation days in addition to your yearly 30-day vacation allowance. - Opportunity for workations abroad using our WorkFlex too
